Explore the manually posted killmail archive from before XMLAPI, CREST, and ESI. This historical collection is isolated from modern statistics.

Wanna experience the old days of EVE? Now you can — with this killmail dump from before XMLAPI / CREST / ESI, back when killmails were manually posted from the client.

There are bound to be fakes and mails of dubious quality — but none of it is calculated into the stats on the rest of the site. It is completely isolated and provided as pure nostalgia.
